title: Notes:
columns:
Proxy Form
I/We ___________________________________________________________________________________CDS
A/C No _______________________of (address)____________________________________________being a
Shareholder(s) of Bank of Kigali Limited, hereby appoint: ____________________________________________
of (address) ____________________________________ or, failing him, the duly appointed Chairman of the
meeting to be my/our proxy, to vote on my/ our behalf at the Annual General Meeting of the Company to be held
on Friday the 27th day of April 2012 at 2.30 p.m., or at any adjournment thereof.
As witness to my/our hands on this __________ day of ________________________ 2012
Signature(s) ___________________________________________________________________
Notes:
1. In case of corporate shareholders and indivudual shareholder who would like to represented at the AGM,
please tear this page carefully and complete as appropriate.
2. This proxy form is to be delivered to the Company Secretary at Bank of Kigali Head Office Plot 6112, Avenue
de la Paix, Kigali, Rwanda not later than 10.00 a.m. on the 20th day of April 2012, failing which it will be
invalid.
3. A proxy form must be in writing and in the case of an individual shall be signed by the shareholder or by his
attorney, and in the case of a corporation the proxy must be either under its common seal or signed by its
attorney or by an officer of the corporation.
